complete_examples.text: In the numerical analysis, the nonlinear behavior of the subgrade soil is revealed by considering shear modulus and traffic loads.

The stiffness nonlinear can be depicted by the reduction of shear modulus of soil, and the reduction curve of shear modulus can be obtained by fitting empirical formulae, written as λ = Gsec Gmax = K (γ, Ip) (σ0)m(γ, Ip)−m0 (9) where λ denotes the reduction coefficient of shear modulus; Gsec and Gmax are the secant shear modulus and initial max shear modulus, respectively; σ0, γ and Ip are the mean effective confining pressure, cyclic shear strain amplitude and plasticity index, respectively.
